mapper.sql: id, corp_key, corp_id, corp_name, agent_id, secret_cipher, callback_base_url, auth_mode, status, remark, created_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM wecom_corp ORDER BY created_at, corp_name

SELECT DISTINCT c.id, c.corp_key, c.corp_id, c.corp_name, c.agent_id, c.secret_cipher, c.callback_base_url, c.auth_mode, c.status, c.remark, c.created_by, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM wecom_corp c JOIN wecom_corp_space s ON s.corp_id = c.corp_id WHERE c.status = 'active' ORDER BY c.corp_name

SELECT FROM wecom_corp WHERE status = 'active'
AND corp_id IN #{id}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY created_at, corp_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wecom_corp (id, corp_key, corp_id, corp_name, agent_id, secret_cipher, callback_base_url, auth_mode, status, remark, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{corpKey}, #{corpId}, #{corpName}, #{agentId}, #{secretCipher}, #{callbackBaseUrl}, #{authMode}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE wecom_corp SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
